## County Information

### Description

Greenup County was named for Christopher Greenup. The county is located in the northeastern area of the state.

### Record Loss

**1937** A disaster destroyed some records. For suggestions about research in places that suffered historic record losses, see [Burned Counties Research](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Burned_Counties_Research "Burned Counties Research") in the FamilySearch Research Wiki.

### Boundary Changes

* **1803--**Greenup County was created 12 December 1803 from [Mason](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Mason_County,_Kentucky_Genealogy "Mason County, Kentucky Genealogy") County.
* **County seat:** Greenup
